securityAndBehaviorAssessment: Atomic revision RPC is security invoker with empty search path and service-role-only EXECUTE; wrong order token cannot replay another proposal because ownership is checked before idempotent replay under a proposal row lock.

A same-key/same-payload request replays its stored response; changed payload or stale revision is rejected. Request record, allowance claim, four jobs and status update share one transaction so failures roll back together.

Client retains immutable request UUID, payload and expected revision through ambiguous failures; polling and retry do not issue a second action for the same intent. Edge errors omit raw tokens and transport diagnostics; upload HTTP logging change is redaction-only.

Scheduler keeps the inactive schedule gate and approved source whitelist; UTC-day PPA listing refresh resets only that source stream. Manual subset refresh is not represented as an all-source freshness guarantee.

Profile GET remains authenticated and owner-scoped. Proposal drafts restore only for the verified account ID or explicit guest; blur/visibility conceals old fields, bounded revalidation distinguishes confirmed sign-out from transient failure, and Retry preserves the hidden same-owner draft.
Pending membership credit bridge migration 20261005133234 is a separate payment authorization change. It is not part of this scoped release and must not be applied via bulk migration push.
